title: Western regional missal gaps: MDZ, Vatican, Liège and Doria originals and Notitiae decree summaries (batch 4)

uses.finding: Bamberg 1499, Augsburg 1496/1510 (Basel)/1555 and Eichstätt 1494/1517 stages; Bamberg and Eichstätt calendar revisions. Augsburg 1496 and 1510 (Basel) are provisional after cold review.
uses.limit: Calendar-level only; bodies uncollated; Bremen untouched.
uses.next_sources: Bodies of the MDZ copies; Bamberg 1507; Eichstätt 1556.

uses.finding: c.1502–1504 Prüss Mainz print and April calendar revision from 1482.
1488 mandate read; 1499 BSB copy is two leaves.
1498 Salzburg print stage and September calendar revision to 1605, absent from the 1506 print's September page.
Speyer approvals: Prot. 697/75 collective; Prot. 2069/71 date conflict retained.

uses.limit: Chartres, Laon, Bourges originals blocked or not digitised.

uses.finding: Zadar OFM calendar is Roman-curial with later additions.
Second Utrecht 1495 copy accessed; Utrecht saints read.
GW attributes commissioning to Bishop Maugras.

searches.outcome: Copies found for Augsburg, Bamberg, Eichstätt, Mainz, Olomouc (fragment), Salzburg and Prague 1498; none for the French, Nordic, Zagreb, Münster, Bremen, Pécs or Prague-1690 books.
searches.unexamined_range: Hits beyond 60; full-text OCR search not used

searches.outcome: Edition identities and digital-copy links extracted for all target incunable missals (notes/gw-missale-extract.txt).
searches.extent_examined: Entries whose heading matched the target diocesan titles

queries: gallica.bnf.fr manifests and ark pages (403 Cloudflare)
archive.org, usuarium.elte.hu, sammlungen.ulb.uni-muenster.de, handrit.is, digi.kansalliskirjasto.fi, mek.oszk.hu (TCP timeouts)
searches.outcome: No challenge was solved or bypassed; no credentials used. Affected gaps are recorded unchanged-searched.
searches.extent_examined: One to three requests per host

searches.repository: Notitiae (Dicastery for Divine Worship) PDF archive
searches.outcome: Prot. 2069/71 (21 Sep 1972, regional calendar), Prot. 697/75 (11 Jul 1975, collective proper confirmation) and Prot. 2282/99/L (11 Nov 2002, Cologne) located and viewed.
searches.extent_examined: Text layers of the named issues; cited pages viewed as images
searches.unexamined_range: Other years and decrees for Swiss dioceses

searches.outcome: Zero documents returned for every query.
Ten hits; the 1519 reproductions are NB-only access; no open original images.

versions.label: Bamberg missal 1499 (Pfeyl)
versions.distinctness_basis: Calendar revision against 1490 (two entries, computistical apparatus).

versions.label: Augsburg missal 1496 (Ratdolt)
versions.distinctness_basis: New mandate by the same bishop as 1489 (larger type, general emendation formula); no calendar difference observed; stage provisional after cold review.

versions.label: Augsburg missal 1510 ([Basel] for Thum)
versions.distinctness_basis: Separately commissioned edition of the same year under the same bishop as Ratdolt 1510; distinct textual state not established (stage provisional after cold review).

versions.label: Augsburg missal 1555 (Dillingen)
versions.distinctness_basis: Mandate claims emendation and added Masses, votives and rubrics.

versions.label: Cambrai missal 1496 (Higman for de Campis)
versions.distinctness_basis: Dated Cambrai print earlier than the 1507 stage.
versions.unresolved: Usuarium 7004 may be the same edition; not linked.

independent_review.scope: The reviewer fetched the cited MDZ, dilibri, DigiVatLib, DONum and Doria images, the three Notitiae issues and nine GW records into its own scratch and looked at them.
